### Worktree cleanup

**You own the audit and exact safe removal, not a broad disk sweep.** Classification is not permission.

Read the [sign-off contract](../references/sign-off.md) and [run accounting](../references/run-contract.md) before coordinating deletion.

1. Preview the user's named repository/targets using `git worktree list --porcelain -z` and fresh native workspace observations. Resolve canonical paths and worktree/repository identities, branch/head, tracked changes, every untracked and ignored file, locks, owner/activity evidence, and loss risk. Keep the preview, run store and proof outside every candidate tree. Sizes and merged/closed state are advisory only.
2. Protect current and main checkouts, run/proof containment, and other users' resources. Hold unknown ownership, activity, locked worktrees, dirty/untracked/ignored data and unsupported app-owned targets. A name, old timestamp, clean Git status, merged branch or PID alone cannot establish ownership/inactivity. Shared caches and simulators are report-only; do not sweep them.
3. Present exact target IDs, canonical identity, complete contents fingerprint, loss risks and hold reasons. Ask through a direct chat question to the user (wait for their reply before continuing) for explicit approval of the eligible target set, or validate an already attributable approval bound to this exact preview. A generic cleanup request is not broad destructive authority. Preserve dirty targets with a proposal, never silently discard them.
4. Re-read current ownership/activity, identity, contents and approval immediately before each action. Any missing evidence, changed fingerprint, new writer or protected containment holds the target. Fresh checks are not a guarantee against an unrelated writer racing; only proceed when idle ownership is positively established. The accounting helper records intent/result, never authorizes or executes deletion.
5. For eligible unmanaged Git worktrees, use ordinary `git worktree remove -- <exact-resolved-path>` without force. Preserve branch refs. No global prune, branch deletion, raw recursive-delete fallback, cache/simulator wipe, or current/main session removal. App-managed resources require an actually available supported host lifecycle mechanism and exact permissions; otherwise report held.
6. Re-list and inspect native results. Record each target as removed, held, failed or uncertain, plus measured reclaimed space only if reliably attributable. In effect accounting, `confirmed` requires actual occurrence, `not_occurred` requires proof of non-occurrence, and `unknown` means uncertainty. An unexecuted held target stays in the audit evidence, not a fabricated effect receipt. After uncertain removal, reconcile before retrying. Absent is success only with the actual confirmed prior removal receipt. Confirm proof survives; [Pause safely](pause-safely.md) can hand off remaining held work.

**Reply:** preview/approval/result evidence, exact removed paths, held/failed/uncertain targets with reasons, preserved data and branch refs, and remaining manual actions.
